import pytest
import more_itertools as mi
from itertools import count

def test_n_1():
    res = [list(c) for c in mi.ichunked(range(5), 1)]
    assert res == [[0], [1], [2], [3], [4]]

def test_n_1_out_of_order():
    it = mi.ichunked(range(5), 1)
    c1 = next(it)
    c2 = next(it)
    assert list(c2) == [1]
    assert list(c1) == [0]

def test_infinite():
    it = mi.ichunked(count(), 3)
    c1 = next(it)
    c2 = next(it)
    assert list(c1) == [0, 1, 2]
    assert list(c2) == [3, 4, 5]

def test_exception_in_iterable():
    def gen():
        yield 1
        yield 2
        raise ValueError("boom")
    
    it = mi.ichunked(gen(), 2)
    c1 = next(it)
    assert list(c1) == [1, 2]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="boom"):
        next(it)
